name: Marriage Covenant
overview: Scripture reveals marriage as a sacred covenant ordained by God, where a man and woman unite to become one flesh, leaving their parents to form a new, God-honoring union (Genesis 2:18, 24). This covenant is not merely a social contract but a spiritual bond witnessed by the Lord, who calls husbands and wives companions bound together in faithfulness (Malachi 2:14). The Bible emphasizes the blessing and favor found in a godly marriage (Proverbs 18:22) and warns against treachery and divorce, underscoring God's hatred for putting away a spouse (Malachi 2:16). Jesus affirms the permanence of this union, declaring that what God has joined, no person should separate (Matthew 19:6).
